cost_model.formula: mandatory_count * max small warmed audit seconds + sum(all legal domain worlds * primitive hit steps) * max warmed large-audit seconds per work unit; geometry scales by raw-ray*cell count; witness validation scales by conservative 3N projection-witness bound
cost_model.limitations: Scenario estimate from small infrastructure samples, not a hard runtime bound. Enumeration filters worlds early; geometry and filesystem/cache costs vary. Full declared pause limits remain mandatory. No solver timings used.
cost_model.orchestration_note: Non-API intervals between the first and last ordinary preflight calls, excluding their summed API time, scaled by call count; includes frequent preflight worker restarts, so it is a conservative process-overhead scenario. Separately measure 32 pairs of zero-increment administrative ledger writes; no solver execution.

scope: Preparation/reference feasibility arithmetic only; no main solver calls or scientific performance analysis

storage_plan.note: 3 KiB per completed call including bounded witnesses, plus 2 GiB for inputs/references/indexes/logs; deterministic compression should reduce closed-job storage, with one job-sized temporary copy.
